samples.summary: Todo file marks all acceptance criteria as already completed ([x]) while the 'Plan' section immediately below describes the same items as work still to be done, and no implementation diff accompanies this PR.
samples.evidence: In docs/tasks/active/20260812-date-display-format-todo.md, the 'Acceptance criteria (from the issue)' section checks off every item as [x] (e.g. '- [x] Settings tab gets a "Date Display Format" option...'), but the very next 'Plan' section lists steps like 'Sorting still compares the raw absolute dates' and file changes as future work ('1. packages/frontend/src/app/documents/document-list-utils.ts — formatExactDate(value, now?) ...'). Since the diff itself contains no source-code changes, marking the criteria as done is internally inconsistent and could mislead a reader into believing the feature is already implemented.
